newsitem.title: USA: Trump cancels hotel plan over tunnel flap - paper.
newsitem.headline: Trump cancels hotel plan over tunnel flap - paper.

text.p: Donald Trump has cancelled two hotel expansion projects in Atlantic City to protest New Jersey's plan for a $350 million road and tunnel project that benefits a rival casino operator, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Friday.
Trump halted plans for a 777-room hotel tower for the Trump Taj Mahal Hotel & Casino and plans for an additional 536 rooms for Trump Castle, the newspaper said.

Last week, Trump filed a federal lawsuit to try to stop the tunnel, arguing that the New Jersey Casino Reinvestment Development Authority's plan to spend $65 million on the project is an unconstitutional use of taxpayer money intended to benefit the elderly and disabled.
The tunnel would lead to a site where developer Steve Wynn plans to build a $750 million casino resort. Trump said that plan would put casinos on the boardwalk at a disadvantage.
